mentions.name: Personal IDE
mentions.description: This is a personal IDE the author is building for themselves, which their non-technical team wants to use after trying tools like Lovable. As part of making it more approachable, the author started building a dialect of JavaScript, but found it increasingly impossible as they got deeper into it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been building and IDE for myself. My non-technical team wants to use it after using lovable and things like that. I started building a dialect of JavaScript to make more approachable but that seems impossible the more I get into it.
mentions.author: digitaltrees
